process_title.mt: Il-protezzjoni tal-individwi fir-rigward tal-ipproċessar ta’ dejta personali u l-moviment liberu ta’ dik id-dejta (Regolament dwar il-Protezzjoni ta’ Dejta Ġenerali)
process_title.de: Schutz natürlicher Personen bei der Verarbeitung personenbezogener Daten und freier Datenverkehr (Datenschutz-Grundverordnung)
process_title.en: Protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, and the free movement of such data (General Data Protection Regulation)
